🧪 Base Pool Construction Review — Last 1000 Draws (#1133–2132)

Narrower than the full 5-pass elimination backtest — just the Base-pool-construction stage, with generation-order detail for both inputs.

Base = Modular Cycle K=33 (walk-forward, native K=28 padded to 33 via cross-method-consensus topKNums()) ∩ xoshiro K=38 seed #692,809 — the exact same Base construction used on the /xoshiro_elim_2130.html-style elimination pages, run retroactively against each of the last 1000 real draws. Every walk-forward-trained component (Modular Cycle's frequency ranking, all 16 methods feeding the cross-method-consensus table used to pad Base to K=33) is trained ONLY on draws strictly before the target draw — no draw ever sees its own future.

Generation order: for each of a draw's 6 actual numbers, this page shows WHERE (if at all) that number fell in each input's own raw pick sequence, before either gets sorted. For xoshiro, that's the order the partial Fisher-Yates shuffle finalizes each position. For Modular Cycle, that's the mod-43 cycle's own frequency ranking (native K=28), followed by the cross-method-consensus padding numbers added to reach K=33 — the order the pick was actually built in. Green = in the top third of that method's own K (an early/high-confidence pick); amber = present but later; grey "—" = never generated by that method at all.

This is Base construction only — it does NOT run the elimination passes (see the full 5-pass elimination backtest for that). Base is a fixed ~30-number pool, so by pure combinatorics only about C(29,6)/C(43,6) ≈ 7.8% of possible 6-number combos could ever be fully contained in it — before any elimination logic runs. Full run took 2604s (43.4 min) for all 1000 draws.

Per-draw results

The ⏳ upcoming draw is pinned at the top, showing the Base pool computed for it — not yet drawn, so there's no actual result to compare against and no hit highlighting. Below it, the 1000 real historical draws are newest first. Each actual number shows two generation-order badges: MC = position within the Modular Cycle K=33 pick's own build order, XO = position within the xoshiro K=38 pick's own Fisher-Yates finalization order. Numbers that hit Base — present in BOTH picks, so they're actually inside the intersection — are highlighted and tagged 🎯 HIT, with a one-line summary underneath the combo spelling out each hit number's index in both sources at a glance.
